Draw ONLY two eyebrows, two mature almond-shaped illustrated anime eyes with eyelids and one tiny catchlight, two very small nose strokes, and a THIN natural closed-mouth line. No individual eyebrow hairs, realistic human eyeballs, pores, flesh, photographic eyelids, wet sculpted lips, or 3D feature shadows. Mouth is understated, approximately 18% of canvas width. No skin fill, face outline, ears, hair, head, neck, body, clothing, scene, text, border, labels or grid. Adult facial proportions and calm neutral expression; no chibi, no childish giant eyes, no heavy makeup or magic. Subject: adult man aged about 25-30; slender confident brows, focused almond-shaped eyes, understated mouth, clean-shaven.
